name: Branded Screen Printing & Embroidery
old_description: Are you looking for high quality apparel? Check out our most popular garments.
about:
Branded Screen Printing & Embroidery was founded in 2009 in Reno, Nevada, as a locally owned and operated shop focused on simplifying custom apparel for area businesses, schools, teams, and events. The company began on Moana Lane with the goal of keeping production in-house to maintain quality and speed, a model it still follows today.

The company provides a full range of decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF/UCP) printing, promotional products, vinyl decals, signs and banners, trade show displays, graphic design, jersey sublimation, online company stores, and contract printing. All production is handled at its Reno facility, allowing control over quality and turnaround. The shop serves both local customers in Reno, Sparks, and Carson City and ships orders nationwide.

Its customer base spans businesses needing work shirts, polos, jackets, and uniforms; K-12 schools ordering spirit wear and fundraiser items; youth and adult sports teams requiring jerseys and practice gear; nonprofits producing volunteer and event apparel; event organizers sourcing staff shirts, giveaways, and banners; and industrial crews in construction, trades, and warehouses seeking hi-vis and durable workwear.

Branded emphasizes in-house production as a differentiator, citing faster communication, consistent quality, and a standard turnaround of five to seven business days after proof approval, with rush options available. Screen printing minimums start at 12 pieces, and some decoration methods have no minimums. Every order includes a digital proof before production, and customers work directly with branding advisors for design support, apparel selection, and timeline management.

name: Bridgelux
old_description: Vertically integrated LED chip maker (epitaxial wafers to light engines)
about:
Bridgelux operates from Fremont, California, as a vertically integrated LED chip manufacturer. The company's founding year is not publicly disclosed in the provided sources. Leadership includes CEO Yiqun Li, who has spoken on high-CRI LEDs and RGBW lighting. Ownership structure and founder names are not specified in the available information.

The company produces LED components ranging from epitaxial wafers to complete light engines. Its product portfolio includes the Bridgelux Strip Series for architectural and commercial applications, the RGBW Series for color-mixing solutions, the F90™ platform that achieves high color rendering without sacrificing efficacy, and the Thrive™ line designed to mimic natural sunlight. The vertical integration spans wafer fabrication, chip processing, and light-engine assembly, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Bridgelux serves the LED lighting industry with a focus on architectural, commercial, and outdoor segments. Recent product launches target flexible linear lighting, high-power outdoor luminaires, and tunable-white plus RGBW color-mixing applications. Customers include lighting OEMs and fixture manufacturers seeking high-CRI, high-efficacy LED platforms, though specific client names are not provided.

The company emphasizes its vertical integration as a core differentiator, enabling control from epitaxy through to packaged light engines. The F90™ technology addresses the traditional trade-off between CRI and efficacy, while Thrive™ aims to replicate the spectral quality of natural light. These platforms are positioned to give customers a competitive advantage in light quality and design flexibility.

name: Bridgeport Insulated Wire Co
old_description: . From magnet wire and Litz wire to military-specification insulations, Bridgeport Insulated Wire delivers the quality and precision your applications demand.
about:
Bridgeport Insulated Wire Co. has operated from Bridgeport, Connecticut since its founding in 1950. The company was established as a U.S.-based manufacturer of precision insulated wire and has maintained domestic production at its Connecticut facility for over seven decades.

The company produces a range of insulated wire products including magnet wire, Litz wire, textile-served wire, and custom bobbin-wound constructions. Its capabilities cover enamel insulation application (with over 12 insulation types from Class 105 to Class 220), wire drawing, tinning, stranding, twisting, and textile serving using fibers such as glass, Nomex, and Kevlar. All machinery is designed and built in-house by the company's engineering staff.

Bridgeport Insulated Wire serves manufacturers in the electrical, aerospace, instrumentation, consumer electronics, motor, and defense sectors. Its wire is specified for transformers, solenoids, fractional motors, synchros, relays, aircraft systems, and military equipment where reliability is critical.

The company emphasizes its military and government approvals—including NEMA MW-1000 compliance, Naval JW-1177/A approval, and UL-listed insulations—as well as its fully domestic supply chain, which it says keeps quality high, lead times short, and communication direct. An in-house engineering department consults on insulation selection and government specification compliance.

name: Bright Eye Solar
old_description: As a locally owned solar installer, we handle everything from your first energy audit to system design, permitting, and installation
about:
Bright Eye Solar is a locally owned solar installation company based in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2010 by Jim Noden, who serves as owner and CEO, the firm began as a full-service installer handling energy audits, system design, permitting, and installation for residential and commercial customers.

The company provides end-to-end solar solutions including rooftop and ground‑mounted photovoltaic systems, battery storage integration, and ongoing maintenance and repair. To date it has completed over 1,600 installations, avoiding an estimated 12,000 metric tons of CO₂ annually and saving customers roughly $2.8 million per year. A team of ten — including a master electrician, project manager, warehouse manager, and multiple solar consultants — supports operations across Pennsylvania, Maryland, and New Jersey.

Bright Eye Solar serves homeowners and businesses throughout Lancaster County and the surrounding region, extending into Maryland and New Jersey. Its residential work covers custom solar arrays for single‑family homes, while commercial projects focus on reducing operational energy costs for companies of various sizes. The firm also assists clients with financing options and incentive navigation.

The company emphasizes its NABCEP certification, transparent proposal process, and a proven local track record as key differentiators. It promotes a streamlined installation workflow that typically completes residential projects within 30 days after approvals, and it offers ground‑mounted alternatives when roof space is limited.

name: Brightstar Solar
old_description: Founded in 2009, we have designed and installed 700+ solar systems.
about:
Brightstar Solar, a family-owned solar installation company, was founded in 2009 by Jonathan and Mona Reese in Marlborough, Massachusetts. The couple started the business with a vision to provide renewable solar power generation with tangible benefits for customers, the environment, and the country.

The company designs and installs photovoltaic systems for residential and commercial properties across Central and Eastern Massachusetts, covering Middlesex, Worcester, Norfolk, Essex, Bristol, and Plymouth counties. Since its inception, Brightstar Solar has completed over 700 installations, ranging from 10 kW to 23.2 kW systems, using all-black panel options for aesthetic integration. The owners oversee every project from initial design through construction, and the crew members each have hundreds of installations to their credit.

Brightstar Solar serves homeowners and businesses seeking to generate their own electricity, offering site evaluations, custom system design, installation, and assistance with utility paperwork and financing. The company does not employ salespeople, relying instead on owner-led consultations and referrals.

The founders started the company to deliver integrity, quality workmanship, and post-installation support that ensures customers' investments outperform. Their approach emphasizes low-pressure engagement and long-term customer relationships, which has earned them a spot on Solar Power World's Top Solar Contractors list for 13 consecutive years.

name: Brilliant Solar
old_description: At Brilliant Solar, we've been powering homes and businesses with clean, renewable energy since 2017. Our recent installations highlight the latest in solar technology, helping customers save on energy costs and reduce their carbon footprint. Check out our latest projects and see how Brilliant Solar can bring sustainable energy to your property!
about:
Brilliant Solar, operating as Brilliant Installations, is based in Toms River, New Jersey. The company was founded in 2017 by Michael Piompino, who had worked in the solar industry since 2010. Piompino serves as founder and chief executive officer, a team that has expanded across multiple markets while retaining a small-business approach.

The firm provides turnkey solar energy systems for homes and businesses, handling rooftop and ground-mount installations, roofing work, battery backup integration, and tree removal to optimize solar access. Services are delivered by NABCEP-certified installers and electricians, in-house roofing crews, and dedicated project managers. The company reports that 90 percent of its systems become operational within 90 days and that 85 percent meet first-year production guarantees.

Brilliant Solar serves residential and commercial customers primarily in New Jersey and eastern Pennsylvania. Projects range from single-family home arrays to combined solar, roofing, and whole-house generator installations. The company coordinates financing through third-party lenders and backs its work with production guarantees and “bumper-to-bumper” warranties.

Piompino founded the business to offer a streamlined, customer-first alternative in a fragmented market. The company emphasizes end-to-end management, from site assessment and engineering through permitting, installation, and ongoing monitoring, aiming to deliver predictable energy costs and carbon reduction without subcontracting core trades.

about:
Bristol Electronics was founded in 1980 in Trevor, Wisconsin, as an independent stocking distributor of electronic components. The company has operated continuously since its inception, building a large inventory and supplier network.

The distributor runs a 30,000-square-foot facility that houses more than one million SKUs and over three billion parts in stock. It offers same-day shipping on more than 250,000 components and leverages a network of over 1,000 global suppliers for non-stock items.

Bristol Electronics serves customers across the electronics sector, including original equipment manufacturers and contract manufacturers who require reliable component supply. The company's sales team draws on decades of industry experience to support procurement needs.

The business emphasizes a customer-first approach, highlighting rapid fulfillment, extensive inventory, and personalized support as its core differentiators. It positions itself as a partner for companies seeking consistent access to electronic parts.

name: Brooks Molds
old_description: Welcome to Brooks Molds. We specialize in the tooling and manufacturing of molds for the cast polymer industry, including cultured marble, Tyvarian and solid surface molds. For over 20 years, we’ve been making molds that are unmatched in performance and unrivaled in craftsmanship, skillfully built with our hands just as much as with our hearts and our minds.  Our cast polymer fiberglass molds are built with quality materials and durable bracing systems, and we made our name producing durable standard and custom molds with industry-leading design and construction. We exceptionally specialize in customizing solutions for your unique mold needs. We will exceed your expectations, and you can count on peace of mind, productivity and innovation when you use our molds.
about:
Brooks Molds is based in Elmore, Alabama. Founded in 1999 as a family-owned and operated business by Bobby Brooks, who began his career in the composites industry in 1984 at Mortar Creek Plastics in Elmore, rising to shop supervisor and master pattern maker before launching his own company. His son Timothy now works alongside him.

The company specializes in the tooling and manufacturing of molds for the cast polymer industry, including cultured marble, Tyvarian, and solid surface applications. Using hand layup techniques, they produce both standard and custom molds—bowls, wall panels, vanity tops, shower pans, shower niches, trim molds, and other custom designs. Each mold is built with fiberglass and heavy-duty bracing systems, and every step is monitored by the owners to ensure durability.

Brooks Molds serves cast polymer manufacturers across the United States. Customers include Majestic Kitchen & Bath, Micalline LLC, Amarillo Marble, Elite Marble, The Bath Collection, Carstin Brands, Easton Industries, Custom Bath Products, St. Louis Marble Company, Custom Designer Surface, Hall Marble, and BSWB Inc. These clients rely on the molds for daily production of cultured marble and solid surface products.

The company emphasizes skill and durability as differentiators, citing over 20 years in the cast polymer mold business, immaculate care of permanent master patterns, and the ability to handle both standard and custom design challenges. Their heavy-duty bracing systems are designed to reduce downtime from mold repairs, and they claim their molds last for years under heavy use.
